title: Google announces TPU 8tx for secure data and 8i Max for long context
summary: Google announced two new tensor processing units: TPU 8tx, aimed at government agencies and tightly regulated industries handling sensitive data, and TPU 8i Max, aimed at ultra-long-context AI applications. TPU 8tx will work alongside AMD chips, while TPU 8i Max integrates two TPU chips in one package to provide more compute and memory capacity. Google is expanding its TPU lineup with workload-specific chips this year, breaking from its previous roughly two-year cadence. The supplied report did not include pricing, availability, or performance figures.
